other.tags: Cinematic orchestral score. Sustained high-register violin and viola sections perform long, legato notes in a minor key. A cello and double bass section provides a slow, descending chromatic counterpoint. The arrangement features a dense, wet reverb with a long decay time. The dynamics swell gradually using orchestral crescendos. No percussion or rhythmic elements are present. The harmonic structure relies on dissonant clusters and suspended chords. 60 BPM. C minor. 4/4 time signature.

[legato cello and double bass enter with descending chromatic line]
[orchestral string swell]

[Outro]
[fading violin harmonics, long reverb tail]

bass.tags: Dark ambient soundscape. A low-frequency sub-bass drone oscillates with a slow, rhythmic pulse. High-frequency metallic textures and granular synthesis artifacts create a shimmering, dissonant layer above the low end. A resonant, filtered sweep moves across the stereo field with a long decay. Periodic mechanical clicks and industrial whirs occur at irregular intervals. The piece lacks a traditional melodic structure or rhythmic grid. Key: C minor. Tempo: 60 BPM.

[Section A]
[resonant filter sweep, stereo panning effects]
[mechanical clicks and industrial whirring]

[Section B]
[dissonant high-frequency shimmer increases in intensity]
[sub-bass pulse slows]

drums.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with a prominent, uncompressed snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a raw, lo-fi aesthetic with high-frequency saturation. Key of E minor. 180 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
